articles.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
articles.title: Data-Driven Electrolyte Design by Electrotopological State Descriptors for Na-Ion Batteries with Minimal Solid-Electrolyte Interphase Dissolution
articles.short: Data-driven electrolyte design cuts SEI loss
articles.headline: High‑EState electrolytes cut SEI loss to 6% & 99.98% CE
articles.did: We measured SEI dissolution for many Na‑ion electrolytes, used a closed‑loop data‑driven workflow to link dissolution to >200 physicochemical descriptors, and **identified the solvent average EState index** as the key predictor.
articles.why: SEI dissolution depletes Na inventory, causing rapid capacity loss; minimizing dissolution with high‑EState electrolytes **reduces Na loss** and enables near‑unity Coulombic efficiency, extending battery life.

term.def: A descriptor combining electronic and topological information of a molecule, reflecting its average electrotopological state.

articles.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
articles.title: A Bowl-Shaped B,N-Tetraquinane Organic Super-Reductant
inst: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

rors.name: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

articles.headline: B,N tetraquinane reduces at –3.2 V, cleaves bonds
articles.did: Synthesized a bowl‑shaped B–N tetraquinane in one high‑yield step and measured a reduction potential of **−3.2 V vs Fc/Fc+**, a record for organic reductants.
articles.why: Topological strain in the 3‑D bowl creates a highly destabilized boron dianion, giving **exceptionally negative reduction potential** and enabling **reductive activation of strong C–Si, C–C, and C–F bonds**.

term.def: A tetraquinane is a fused four‑ring system composed of quinane units, forming a highly strained bowl‑shaped scaffold.

articles.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
articles.title: Dynamic Li+/Na+-Exchanging Interphase Stabilizes High-Voltage Ni-Rich Cathodes for 557 Wh kg–1 Lithium Batteries
articles.headline: 80% capacity retained after 511 cycles at 4.7 V
articles.did: A **Na⁺-based solid electrolyte coating** (Na₃Zr₂Si₂PO₁₂) on NCM811 undergoes **Li⁺/Na⁺ exchange**, forming a fast Li⁺‑conducting L‑NZSP interphase and inserting Na⁺ into the cathode lattice.
articles.why: The L‑NZSP layer **suppresses high‑voltage parasitic reactions**, while the incorporated Na⁺ **pillars stabilize the oxygen lattice**, reducing chemo‑mechanical degradation and enabling long‑life high‑energy operation.

term.def: A protective layer formed at the cathode surface that governs electrolyte decomposition and ion transport.

articles.title: Spin and Charge Engineering of a BiCuMn Nanoalloy Catalyst for Industrial‐Scale Electrosynthesis of Glycine
inst: Beijing National Laboratory for Molecular Sciences
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
State Key Laboratory of Metastable Materials Science and Technology

rors.name: Beijing National Laboratory for Molecular Sciences
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
State Key Laboratory of Metastable Materials Science and Technology

articles.headline: 78.9% FE glycine at 533 mA cm⁻², 1000 h operation
articles.did: A Bi‑based nanoalloy with atomically dispersed Cu and Mn (**BiCuMn@C**) was synthesized and applied to **glycine electrosynthesis**.
articles.why: Cu induces **d‑p hybridization** with Bi, improving nitrogen species adsorption, while Mn supplies **spin‑polarized electrons** to *NO, enabling its hydrogenation to *NHO and breaking the *NO/*NHO scaling relationship, thus raising activity and selectivity.

term.def: Interaction between d orbitals of Cu and p orbitals of Bi that alters electronic structure and adsorption properties.

articles.title: Steric Asymmetry‐Induced Hyperconjugation Enables Stable Anode‐Free Sodium Pouch Cells
inst: State Key Laboratory of Metal Matrix Composites

rors.name: State Key Laboratory of Metal Matrix Composites

articles.short: Steric asymmetry boosts Na‑free pouch cells
articles.headline: 85.9% capacity after 1600 cycles in Na‑free pouch
articles.did: The authors selected 1‑ethoxy‑2‑methoxyethane (EEME) because its **sterically asymmetric ethyl terminus creates a hyperconjugation‑enabled polarization pathway**, yielding moderate Na⁺ coordination and a persistent anion‑affinitive site that forms a NaF‑rich interphase for **highly reversible,…
articles.why: Steric‑induced hyperconjugation **amplifies the positive electrostatic potential** of EEME, creating an **anion‑affinitive site that guides PF₆⁻ with Na⁺**, enabling correlated ion transport and stable, high‑rate anode‑free Na batteries.

term.def: Delocalization of electrons from a σ‑bond into an adjacent empty or antibonding orbital, influencing molecular polarity and reactivity.

articles.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
articles.title: Colloidally Prepared Homogeneous Wide-Bandgap Perovskites for Efficient Tandem Solar Cells with Industrial Silicon
inst: Southern University of Science and Technology

rors.name: Southern University of Science and Technology

articles.headline: Colloid‑guided WBG films give 34% PCE in Si tandems
articles.did: We identified the precursor suspension as the source of inhomogeneity and introduced long‑chain alkylphosphonic acids to engineer colloidal intermediates, **directing rapid nucleation and slow crystallization** for uniform WBG films.
articles.why: Homogeneous WBG perovskite layers **lower trap density**, enabling tandem devices with industrial Si to reach a certified 34.01% PCE and retain 93% after 1211 h and 88% after 1000 h.

term.def: Long‑chain organic acids bearing a phosphonic (–PO₃H₂) group, used to coordinate metal ions and modulate colloidal stability.

articles.title: Electric‐Field‐Manipulated Reaction Pathway Engineering in Lupinus micranthus ‐Like High‐Entropy Alloy Nanowires for Direct Alcohol Fuel Cells
articles.headline: Methanol oxidation 3.76 A mg Pt⁻¹, 8.36× Pt/C
articles.did: We synthesized anisotropic PtFeCoIrRhCu high‑entropy alloy nanowires that create a **local electric field** through strain‑induced lattice distortion and charge redistribution, enabling a **directional capture‑migration‑dissociation** relay of interfacial water for low‑potential hydroxyl generation.
articles.why: The hydroxyl species **accelerate CO oxidative removal**, opening a non‑CO pathway and delivering 3.76 A mg Pt⁻¹ activity with a **163.06 mW cm⁻²** peak power density in a direct methanol fuel cell.

term.def: A solid solution of five or more principal elements in near‑equal proportions, giving high configurational entropy and unique properties.

articles.title: Quenching or Accelerating Large‐Scale Surface Reconstruction by the Lightest Element: Facet‐Dependent Hydrogen‐Induced Reconstruction (HIR)
inst: Collaborative Innovation Center of Chemistry for Energy Materials

rors.name: Collaborative Innovation Center of Chemistry for Energy Materials

articles.headline: H speeds Pd dispersion on Pd‑Ag(100), slows it on (111)
articles.did: Large‑scale MD simulations **resolved H‑driven surface reconstruction kinetics** on Pd‑covered Ag, revealing Pd‑Ag exchange at domain edges and Ag encapsulation of Pd, with facet‑dependent rates.
articles.why: The facet‑dependent HIR **creates Pd₃ triangular sites** that enhance selective acetylene hydrogenation, demonstrating that hydrogen‑induced reconstruction governs active‑site structure and catalytic selectivity.

term.def: Rearrangement of a catalyst surface caused by adsorbed hydrogen atoms, altering atomic positions and exposing new active sites.

articles.title: Dipolar Heterointerface Enabled by Molecular Zwitterionicity for Rigid and Flexible Perovskite Solar Cells
inst: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications

rors.name: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications

articles.headline: Dipolar interface gives 26.86% efficiency in rigid PSCs
articles.did: A zwitterionic molecule, Pyps, was placed at the SnO₂ ETL/perovskite interface to form a **dipolar heterointerface** that **reinforces bonding and passivates defects**, while its intrinsic dipole aligns energy levels for better charge extraction.
articles.why: The dipolar interface **enhances interfacial adhesion and conductivity**, leading to **high efficiencies and long‑term operational stability**, crucial for both rigid and flexible perovskite solar cells.

term.def: Molecule bearing both positive and negative charges in the same species, but overall neutral.

articles.title: Synergistic Interface Lubrication and Anion Anchoring in a Composite Solid‐State Electrolyte for Dendrite‐Free and Wide‐Temperature Zinc Metal Batteries
articles.short: Composite solid electrolyte for dendrite‑free Zn
articles.headline: Zn//Zn cell 2000 h; Zn//Cu CE 99.75% for 1000 cycles
articles.did: A composite solid‑state electrolyte was built by embedding EMIMTFSI ionic liquid and BN nanosheets into a PVDF‑HFP polymer matrix, **suppressing polymer crystallization** and **anchoring TFSI− via Lewis acid‑base interactions**.
articles.why: The plasticizer yields **enhanced ionic conductivity** and better contact, and BN‑TFSI anchoring controls Zn2+‑TFSI− coordination, enabling **uniform Zn deposition** and high Zn2+ transference, preventing dendrites.

term.def: A non‑covalent interaction where a Lewis acid accepts an electron pair from a Lewis base, here binding TFSI− to BN.
